name: Can you build a fourplex as an owner-occupant?

mainEntity.name: Can an owner live in one unit and rent the other three in a fourplex project?
mainEntity.text: Can an owner live in one unit and rent the other three in a fourplex project?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is a common intent because some owners want to reduce carrying costs while building long-term wealth. The key issues are whether the project’s financing supports owner-occupancy, whether the unit mix works for the owner’s needs, and whether the site design gives the primary unit enough privacy. Searchers also need to know that owner-occupant plans can influence how they think about parking, entries, outdoor space, and noise separation. A useful page should explain that living in one unit can be a practical strategy, but it still requires the same permitting, construction coordination, and quality control as a pure investment project. The answer should also encourage owners to plan for future resale or refinancing from the beginning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, in many cases an owner can live in one unit and rent the others, but the financing, design, and permit strategy should be set up with that use in mind. Owner-occupant projects can affect loan terms and unit mix.
